[Multi-platform][2017][Boss rush arena style game] I remember reading about this game in a post about video game music. It's a series of boss battles where the protagonist attempts to escape a prison on another planet. If I remember correctly, it opens with a mysterious figure encouraging the protagonist to break out and possibly giving them some kind of power or weapon. As the game progresses, it is slowly revealed that the protagonist is a dangerous criminal who was imprisoned by some kind of law enforcement and the bosses you slay throughout are actually noble heroes. I know it became pretty mildly popular, it's on PC and PlayStation.
